name: Kaizuka Shinano
source: A teacher who was temporarily assigned to Soyo Gakuen. The teacher from the original country who was in charge of the main character's class was hospitalized due to an accident, so she came temporarily. The impression that she is usually a modest and kind older sister. There are some things that are a little dodgy, and the harder you work, the more you get to spin. In addition, the teacher in the original country was also an advisor to the Occult Study Group, so she decided to take on that too.
